Venue Address

Wild Woods Tiger Resort

Survey No. 147, West Pench, Suwardhara, Kolitmara Road, Tehsil Parseoni, Nagpur District, Maharashtra 441104, India.

Park Gate Proximity

Kolitmara & Banera Gates

Nestled at the edge of Pench National Park (Maharashtra) near Banera Gate and 12.5 km from Kolitmara Safari Gate, overlooking pristine forest canopy and riverfront clearings.

Official Property Info

Hospitality & Timings

22 luxury teak and stone accommodations, 2 outdoor swimming pools, lawn pavilions, and 24-hour front desk hospitality.

Visit Resort Website ↗

By Air

Nagpur International Airport (NAG)

Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport, Nagpur is approximately 58 km (36 miles / ~1 hr 15 mins drive) via NH-44 and Parseoni–Kolitmara Road.

By Rail

Nagpur Junction & Godhani

Approximately 40.4 km from Nagpur City Centre and Nagpur Junction Railway Station, with scenic highway connectivity directly to Suwardhara, West Pench.

By Road

Scenic Forest Approach

Complimentary private parking is available at the resort. Guests driving from Nagpur or Pune can follow the Mansar–Parseoni–Kolitmara corridor.

January Forest Climate

Crisp & Golden Winter

Mid-January in Pench features pleasant sunny afternoons (24°C–27°C) ideal for our daytime Haldi Carnival, and crisp starlit evenings (11°C–14°C)—we recommend carrying a light shawl or velvet wrap for evening functions.

Check-In & ID

Guest Guidelines

Our Welcome Celebration begins at 12 O'clock on 16 January 2027 (standard resort check-in is 12:30 PM–2:00 PM; check-out is 11:00 AM). Please carry a valid government photo ID (Aadhaar, Passport, or Driving License).

Wilderness Setting

Eco-Luxury Architecture

Crafted with natural teak, organic clay, and eco-sustainable stone amidst tranquil gardens, bonfires, and the serene call of spotted deer.
